entries.asks: user turn 3: Implement parseDuration in src/duration.ts so test/duration.test.ts passes.

answer.text:
Done. `parseDuration` in src/duration.ts:23 is implemented: it scans the string with a sticky-on-position loop over `\s*(\d+)([dhms])`, summing `d`/`h`/`m`/`s` values, and throws if anything fails to match contiguously (empty input, a bare number, an unknown unit, or leftover text). All 3 tests in test/duration.test.ts pass.

One note: the full `node --test` run also picks up test/slug.test.ts, which fails on a pre-existing `slug` implementation (`'hello---world'` vs `'hello-world'`). That's outside this task's scope, so I left it alone; the only file I changed is src/duration.ts.
